_comment: THE INDEX WRITER REGISTRY. Declarative manifest of every Azure AI Search index the fleet's retrieval tools can query, and -- critically -- WHAT WRITES IT. Consumed by setup/index-writer-gate.mjs (CI gate) and skills/azure-canary/canary.mjs (freshness canary). WHY IT EXISTS: on 2026-07-13 we found that `otchealth-brain` (67,645 docs) -- the ONLY index the gateway's brain_search queried, whose tool description told every agent 'Ground answers here and cite' -- HAD NO WRITER ANYWHERE. It was an ad-hoc one-time snapshot created outside both repos and outside IaC (git log -S across all 541 commits: the string first appears 2026-07-10, in a READER). It sat frozen for ~12 days while every agent grounded answers in it. Nothing caught it because (a) a job literally named `brain-reindex` ran green every 6h -- it actually refreshes memory-exec, and was named back when memory-exec WAS 'the brain' (company-brain/brain.mjs still labels it '(shared brain)'); (b) the only freshness signal we had was a doc-count FLOOR, and a frozen index never drops below a floor -- it stays identical forever; (c) expected-resources.json proves every JOB exists but asserts nothing about what a job WRITES. THE RULE THIS FILE ENFORCES: an index that any retrieval tool can query MUST have a registered writer that actually exists and is actually scheduled. If you wire a new index into a search tool, add it here, or index-writer-gate.mjs fails CI. If an index has no writer, it does not get to be a source of truth.

indexes.note: The real shared brain. `brain-reindex` is NOT misnamed historically -- brain.mjs labels this index '(shared brain)'. The name only became a trap once the separate `otchealth-brain` index was created and stole the noun.

max_age is 48h not 4h: the librarian runs hourly but only pushes when there is NEW content, so a quiet day is legitimately quiet. The canary asserts the WRITER is alive (via the dead-job sweep) AND that content is not ancient -- not that content arrives hourly.
MNPI ring. Source docs change slowly; a week of no new finance docs is normal, so max_age is generous. Liveness of the WRITER is the real assertion here.
ATTORNEY-PRIVILEGED. The canary reads ONLY the newest indexed_at timestamp and the doc count -- never document CONTENT. Metadata-only, so the freshness check does not breach the privilege wall.

decommissioning.note: NO WRITER, EVER. Ad-hoc one-time snapshot (~2026-07-01) created outside both repos and outside IaC; frozen at exactly 67,645 docs. Retired as a retrieval target by mcp-server PR #103 (brain_search now federates the live rooms above). Deliberately listed here, NOT in `indexes`, so index-writer-gate.mjs FAILS if any retrieval tool is ever re-pointed at it. ARM deletion of the index + the orphan `otchealth-brain-search` service requires a delete path the gateway does not expose (no azure_search_index_delete / no service delete) -- pending a human hand. Until then this entry is the tombstone.
